title: Sure as the Morning
old_p1: Heavenly Father’s people had wandered far away from Him. Then they said to each other, “Come, and let us return unto the Lord.” Return means to come back home.
“He will heal us,” they said. “He will bind us up.” To bind up means to wrap a hurt, the way careful hands wrap a scraped knee.
old_p2: They said Heavenly Father comes as sure as the morning. The sun comes up every day, so everyone knew morning never forgets to come.
“He shall come unto us as the rain,” they said. Farmers needed rain for their plants to grow, so rain meant a gift right on time.
Morning always comes after the night. Tonight, feel safe knowing Heavenly Father comes to you that surely.
p1: Heavenly Father’s people had wandered far from Him, and they missed Him. In Hosea’s book, they said, “Come, let’s go back to the Lord.”
They said, “He will heal us. He will wrap up our hurts.” A mom puts a bandage on a scraped knee. Heavenly Father helps our hurts get better like that.
They said He would come to them as sure as the morning. Every day, the sun comes up. Morning never forgets to come.
p2: They said He would come like the rain, too. Farmers waited for rain, because plants need water. Heavenly Father’s help comes just when it is needed.
The sun has gone down tonight, but morning will surely come. Heavenly Father’s love is that sure. If you ever feel far from Him, you can come back with a prayer.
